::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/renewal_estimate"}
#docs
No body, no writes. `estimate` is null when there is no next term to bill (cancelling, non-renewing, or the cycle cap reached). By default it excludes metered usage, which is not final until the term ends, so it is the fixed-charge floor; `include_usage_so_far=true` adds the usage recorded so far.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | Subscription id (sub_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ignore_scheduled_cancellation` | `string` | no | `true` prices the renewal a pending cancellation (end-of-term flag, specific date, or exhausted cycles) would stop, instead of returning null. |
| `ignore_scheduled_changes` | `string` | no | Omitted, a scheduled change that lands at or before the renewal is applied first, so the estimate prices the items it leaves (`estimate.scheduled_change` names it). A change it cannot price here (a pause, more than one change, or a change that starts a new term) makes `estimate` null and is named in `unpriced_scheduled_change`; `false` refuses (400) instead. `true` prices today's items. |
| `include_delayed_charges` | `string` | no | Queued unbilled charges ride on the renewal and are included by default; `false` leaves them out. |
| `use_existing_balances` | `string` | no | Customer credit (promotional, refundable, excess) is applied by default; `false` previews with none. |
| `include_usage_so_far` | `string` | no | `true` adds the metered usage recorded so far in the current term, with its minimum-spend true-up, when this renewal is the invoice that bills it. Coupons, credits and tax then apply as on the real invoice. Default `false`: the fixed-charge estimate. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `renewal_estimate`. One of `renewal_estimate`. |
| `subscription` | `string` | The subscription the estimate is for. |
| `estimate` | `object` | The estimated renewal invoice. |
| `unpriced_scheduled_change` | `object` | Set when `estimate` is null because a scheduled change or pause that lands first cannot be priced here. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Invalid proration state |
| `404` | No such subscription |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/subscriptions/sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/renewal_estimate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
